comment: Parameters of the reference program's heats: its pace and its racecraft among the three opponents. The planner, QP and tracker keep their own parameter file (params.json). Every number has its reason in 'provenance'.

provenance.strategy.practice_factor, practice_cap_m: practice: one timed lap at the mapping phase's limit less 10 % (1.8 m/s) at 0.88 of the grip-limited speed, then a stop at 2 m/s^2 and the session is closed (nothing of practice is scored)
provenance.strategy.race_factor: the pace of the heats: 0.93 of the grip-limited speed (a factor on speed: every grip-dependent capability x 0.93^2), the pace its tracker holds over whole sessions without a touch; against opponents at 0.70-0.80 of their own lines' speed this is the speed difference a pass needs
provenance.strategy.rejoin_dev_m: when the racecraft hands back no path while the car is more than 0.1 m off its racing line, the car joins the line on a join path (never a step of the path under the tracker)
provenance.racecraft.plan_every_ticks, pass_every_t: predictions and checks every 0.1 s, a pass tried every 0.2 s
provenance.racecraft.horizon_s, dt_s: a pass of an opponent at 0.80 of its speed takes 3-6 s from following to merging, a train of two up to 9 s: 10 s on a 0.1 s grid
provenance.racecraft.look_min_m, look_s: opponents ahead within 10 m or 3 s at the car's speed are considered for the following law
provenance.racecraft.sep_m: lateral distance of the two reference points beside an opponent: car width 0.185 m, 0.215 m between the bodies, three times an undisturbed opponent's largest tracking error (0.07 m)
provenance.racecraft.lane_m: an opponent's driver slows for anything within 0.1425 m of its line; with the car's half width 0.0925 m that is 0.235 m between the reference points; 0.30 m counts as in its band
provenance.racecraft.overlap_margin_m: longitudinal margin added at both ends of the stretch where the two bodies overlap along the track
provenance.racecraft.merge_gap_m: the car's tail to the opponent's nose when the car re-enters the opponent's band ahead of it: the opponent's driver slows for a car ahead in its band only when that car is slower than its own cruise speed, so 0.5 m (twice its stop gap) does not slow it while the car pulls away
provenance.racecraft.caught_gap_m: after re-entering a passed opponent's band the car keeps at least 0.3 m between its tail and the opponent's nose (the opponent's stop gap 0.25 m plus a margin), so it does not merge just before braking harder than that opponent
provenance.racecraft.follow_gap_m: reference points 1.7 m apart behind an opponent (1.27 m between the bodies), inside the 1.5-2 m that racing teams report as a stable following distance
provenance.racecraft.follow_min_m, anticipate_s: the following law is bounded by the opponent's predicted motion over the next 2 s: braking gently the car stays 1.2 m (reference points, 0.77 m between the bodies) behind it, so it slows in time when the opponent closes on a slower car
provenance.racecraft.follow_gain_per_s: the following law closes a gap error of 1 m at 1 m/s
provenance.racecraft.follow_decel_frac, cap_fall_fr: the following law brakes at 0.25 grip x g, inside the fall the tracker allows a cap (0.4 of the friction left, at least 0.2 grip x g)
provenance.racecraft.train_close_m, follow_gap_trai: an opponent running less than 2 m (reference points) behind another in its band brakes hard and often to keep its own distance (its driver's command falls at 0.7 grip x g); behind such an opponent the car keeps 2.6 m (at least 1.8 m) instead of 1.7 m, because its own cap falls only gently
provenance.racecraft.follow_engage_m, follow_leave_: behind an opponent in the way, closer than 4 m between the reference points, the car moves onto the opponent's own line and follows it there; it leaves that line when the opponent is 8 m ahead or behind it; a follow path that would need a step brake is tried again after 0.5 s
provenance.racecraft.train_gap_m: opponents whose reference points are closer than 2.0 m are passed in one manoeuvre; with more room between two opponents the car may pass the rear one and slot in between (its tail merge_gap_m ahead of one, its nose behind the other), the simulation decides
provenance.racecraft.start_hold_s, start_cruise_fra: no pass while the opponent in the way is below 85 % of its pace for the first time or within the first second: the bunch on the grid
provenance.racecraft.dev_margin_m, dev_fade_m: the pass offset adds 2 cm to sep_m; an opponent's present tracking error is carried into its prediction and fades out over 1 m
provenance.racecraft.ramp_min_m, ramp_max_m, ramp_l: lateral ramps of a pass or follow path: smoothstep with peak lateral acceleration 0.4 x grip x g at the factor, between 1.5 and 5 m
provenance.racecraft.return_lat_frac, return_ramp_m: a return to the racing line is gentler (0.18 x grip x g, up to 6 m) because the car often brakes meanwhile; below 5 cm off the line no return path is built, within 0.1 m the car goes back onto the line directly
provenance.racecraft.entry_slack_mps: a path whose own profile at the car is more than 0.15 m/s below the car's speed would need a step brake and is refused
provenance.racecraft.emergency_gap_m: bodies less than 0.5 m apart ahead in a band: the cap drops to the opponent's speed less 0.3 m/s
provenance.racecraft.pass_window0_m, extend_m, merg: the first pass path keeps the side for 6 m after the ramp; when the simulated merge point lies beyond, the side is kept to it plus 1 m (at least 2 m more) and the path is built again, at most 3 times
provenance.racecraft.window_margin_m: a train is passed with each opponent's line offset only where the car is beside that opponent (from the simulated pass), widened by 1 m at both ends for the timing
provenance.racecraft.room_slack_m: an offset up to 5 cm beyond the car's lateral limit is clipped to the limit; the simulation of the clipped path decides
provenance.racecraft.after_pass_s: a conflict with an opponent outside the pass counts against the plan only until 1.5 s after the pass is complete; later the car follows it or plans the next pass
provenance.racecraft.stretch_max_frac: a pass whose stretch beside the opponents would exceed 0.9 of the lap is not planned (its end would wrap round to the car)
provenance.racecraft.keep_plan_s: a pass not yet released is dropped only for a conflict within the next 2 s; a later conflict rebuilds it on its side or keeps it with the release blocked until the next clean check
provenance.racecraft.check_s: a follow path or a return path is taken only when the simulated car on it keeps the rules for the next 2.5 s
provenance.racecraft.pass_factor: the pace on a pass path: 0.90 of the grip-limited speed, below the 0.93 of race_factor; at 0.93 the tracking error at the end of a pass reached 0.25 to 0.45 m for a moment and the car touched duct pieces next to its line, at 0.90 the car comes back onto its line with less lateral load (a higher pass pace gave more passes and more close calls)
provenance.racecraft.opp_accel_frac, opp_decel_frac: the opponents' driver: command rises at 0.35 and falls at 0.7 grip x g per second (the prediction rises a little slower, 0.33), speed law read 0.3 m ahead, it follows a slower car in its band at about 0.53 m between the bodies; a car whose reference point is within 0.25 m of its line is in its band
provenance.racecraft.profile_extra_m: the speed profile of a new path is computed from the car to 12 m beyond the end of its stretch (more than the braking distance from top speed at the lowest grip, 6.1^2 / (2 x 0.865 x 0.45 g) = 4.9 m); beyond that the path is the line it joins and keeps that line's profile
provenance.strategy.race_wall_clear_m: the heats' racing line and the racecraft's lateral limits keep 0.18 m between the car's envelope and every duct capsule or tape, against the planner's 0.08 m: after a pass, or when it accelerates from behind a slow car, the tracking error reaches 0.1 to 0.4 m for a moment, and the planner's line passes some duct pieces within 0.05 m
